reviews.text: I took my dog ​​to be washed by them, friendly and kind people, welcoming, clean and organized place, exceptional experience, highly recommended.

Great professionalism, great empathy, and a wonderful welcome. I brought my poodle, Minou, for the first time and was very pleased, not only with the wonderful relationship we established with her, but also with the excellent bath and grooming she received!!! Much better than I could have expected. Finally, I was pleased to see that they cleaned her ears very well and informed me that she had an ear infection and advised me to see a vet.
Overall, I was very satisfied, so much so that I've booked a bath in 21 days and a bath and grooming in 45 days.
Enzo Armentano

I took my Maltese for grooming and was truly satisfied. The haircut was done with great care and precision, respecting the dog's characteristics. Excellent attention to detail, impeccable cleanliness, and a lot of gentleness during the treatment.
The result was truly beautiful: my Maltese came out clean, smelling fresh, and with a neat, natural cut. The professionalism and love for animals are evident. Highly recommended!
Excellent grooming

I'm a regular customer and am always completely satisfied. My poodle is always treated with great care, professionalism, and lots of love. The cut is always impeccable, and the dog comes out clean, smelling good, and calm. You can see the passion and attention she puts into her work. I recommend this grooming salon to anyone looking for quality, expertise, and a love for animals. Congratulations and thank you, I'll definitely keep coming back!
Professional. Impeccable cutting care.
Great professional! I highly recommend him!

I took my poodle Teddy to Ciro Coraggio, and the experience was simply extraordinary. Not only is he an impeccable professional, but he has a magical touch: my dog ​​came home with a shiny coat, a perfect cut, and an energy I hadn't seen in a long time. It's clear he puts passion into every step, with an attention to detail and care that makes him unique. If you're looking for a groomer who truly makes a difference, he's the absolute best. Thank you so much for making my little one so happy!
Highly recommended to anyone who wants the best for their pet!

I began my journey with Ciro with a basic course and have never stopped following him since. He is an excellent teacher, able to convey knowledge you won't find in books because it is the fruit of his thirty years of experience. He manages to bring out the best in each student and immediately understands their talents and weaknesses, and he is able to provide the right foundation for his students thanks to his clear explanations and patience. Thanks to him, a great passion for poodles was born in me, so much so that it even drove me to undertake a competitive course, where he continues to support me with his advanced lessons, guiding me in competitions and managing to reach the podium. The basic course is just a springboard into the wonderful world of pet grooming, if undertaken with courage.

The best groomer in Naples.
I've known him for a long time and have always entrusted him with my Bichon Frises, always being more than satisfied with his work.
I highly recommend him.

Top.
Ciro, without competition!
Our first experience with Ciro, we immediately noticed his professionalism, and he suggested the best solution for my cocker spaniel, who had been reborn after his grooming. Excellent!

Exceptional training course!
Professionalism, cleanliness, and so much passion.
I had a great time and learned so much thanks to the expert and knowledgeable tutors.
If you're looking for a place to learn the art of grooming at the highest level, this is the place.
Thank you for everything, Ciro. I'll take all your teachings seriously.
Five well-deserved stars!
Great professionalism, empathy, and kindness. Ciro Coraggio is incomparable; the dogs are beautiful after his care.
Professionalism and courtesy, the friendliness of Mr. Ciro unique, highly recommended!
Extremely friendly, professional, and experienced staff with exemplary patience...in short, the best academy in the Colli Aminei area.
A unique experience. Professionalism combined with love and passion for this work. Thank you, Maestro, for your dedication and, above all, patience with your students.
I'm very happy with the staff, they're welcoming. They've been making my Enea beautiful for 5 years.
Great teacher, always personal and professional excellence!!👏🫂 …

I've tried several groomers for my miniature schnauzer, and he's definitely on a different level. I tried several, some closer to home, before finally settling on one that I think is just right. He's definitely on a different level, no offense, but it shows when someone's done their homework.

An excellent experience with Ciro Coraggio. He groomed Joy, a Giant Schnauzer, and the result was simply perfect. His great professionalism, passion, and attention to detail are immediately evident: the cut is impeccable and shows off the breed to its fullest. Joy came out looking beautiful, immaculately clean, and above all, serene, a sign of a gentle and respectful approach to animals.
I would definitely recommend Ciro to anyone looking for a competent, reliable groomer who truly loves his work. We'll definitely be back.

I'm currently attending the Ciro Coraggio Grooming Academy, and I have to say it's a truly fantastic experience! From day one, I knew I was in the right place: Ciro is a special person, passionate and incredibly competent, who puts his heart and soul into everything he does. He guides you step by step, patiently and eager to help you grow.

The lessons are practical, clear, and full of helpful advice. You learn so much and always work with respect and animal welfare in mind, which is essential to me. The environment is welcoming and calm, and makes you immediately feel part of a big family.

I wholeheartedly recommend this school to anyone who wants to learn the true art of grooming from a Master who truly knows everything about our four-legged friends.

I'm taking this grooming course and I'm really enjoying it. Ciro is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and always available to explain each step in a simple and understandable way. Thanks to his clear method and experience, I'm learning so much and feeling increasingly confident in the various techniques.
I highly recommend this course to anyone looking for serious training in the world of grooming: quality, professionalism, and a truly enjoyable learning environment!
Absolutely the best in Naples is not only that.

We've been taking our poodle named Red to Ciro Coraggio's "Grooming Academy" for almost four years.
Red is welcomed with kindness and attention by the staff, who demonstrate expertise and love for animals, making him feel at ease and not at all nervous as he might have elsewhere. The salon is clean, organized, and above all safe. Ciro Coraggio, the groomer and owner of the salon, is meticulous in his work and attentive to detail. He solves our puppies' most difficult knots without shaving them completely, performing all haircuts entirely with scissors. My Red, when he leaves the "Grooming Academy" salon, walks down the street proudly, feeling like a star; everyone in Benevento knows him thanks to Ciro's haircut.
I highly recommend "Grooming Academy" to all poodle owners looking for high-quality service.
Raffaella Red Alessandro
A supreme professional. His extensive teaching demonstrates an unparalleled professionalism that extends to his team.

I've known Ciro for 19 years, he's excellent, professional...
I had the experience of having a Cooker and people would stop me in the street after grooming... Today I have a poodle and what can I say, he's a sight to behold after a bath... I recommend him for your dog... Bravo!
Wonderful person, friendly and kind. A true Master, extremely knowledgeable and available. I've been attending his academy for a few months and I couldn't have made a better choice!

Ciro Coraggio is a true professional. Precision, expertise, dedication, and a loving nature are his defining qualities. And I also believe he's the most awarded vet in Italy. My dog, after one of his treatments, becomes incredibly beautiful...
Kindness, professionalism, and experience make Ciro Coraggio the perfect place to have your dog groomed.

When I began my grooming journey, I never imagined how important it would be to have a guide like Maestro Ciro Coraggio. He's not only an extremely competent professional, but also someone capable of conveying the true essence of this profession: respect for the animal, attention to detail, and a sincere passion for every nuance of the craft.
Working alongside him is formative in every way. The patience with which he taught me techniques, the precision of his movements, the importance of knowing how to read animals' language and adapt to them... these are all things that go beyond simple practice: they are the fruit of years of experience and a deep love for this profession.
He taught me that grooming isn't just about aesthetics, but about well-being, trust, and relationships. He taught me the value of dedicating time to every dog ​​or cat that comes into the shop, always treating them as unique creatures, with their own sensitivities and fears. And he gave me confidence when I thought I wasn't up to it, pushing me to believe in my abilities and improve day after day.
Today I can say I've grown a lot, both professionally and personally, thanks to his example and dedication. That's why I recommend Ciro Coraggio Academy not only to those looking for an experienced and knowledgeable groomer, but also to those who want to learn this profession with the right approach, mindful and respectful. A true role model, one that leaves a lasting impression.
I will always be grateful to you, thank you, Maestro. ♥️
Professionalism, competence and a lot of love to make my Zeus a masterpiece... and with an American golden also a lot of patience
I've found Ciro Coraggio to be professional and empathetic. His team is special. Every time I bring my Leo, he feels right at home. I wouldn't trade him for anyone. Thank you so much.

I had the opportunity to do a trial day with Maestro Ciro Coraggio: professional, precise, attentive, and meticulous! If this is the profession you want to pursue, you can only go to the best. Professionalism pays, but it will also repay you! Thank you for everything!

Skill, patience, dedication, and professionalism are just some of the qualities I can attribute to Ciro and his entire staff. My dog ​​Penny and I have been following him everywhere on his well-deserved career path for years. 😍 All this is complemented by a wonderful, warm, and welcoming location dedicated to all our pups🐾🐾🐾🐾♥️♥️♥️♥️!!
Highly recommended! You are a force to be reckoned with! 💪🏻♥️

I'm truly thrilled with the service Ciro Coraggio provides. The grooming was impeccable, done with great care. My dog ​​came home smelling fresh, well-groomed, and visibly more relaxed. He was punctual and helpful, and the price was absolutely fair for the quality of the service received. I highly recommend Ciro to anyone looking to ensure their pet receives quality grooming.

Courtesy, helpfulness, and great professionalism!
I've been entrusting my four furry friends to Master Ciro for a long time, and the results of his grooming are always satisfying and impeccable!
Last but not least, he shows extraordinary love for my puppies, who place themselves in his hands with immense serenity.
Quality, professionalism, competence and courtesy.

After much searching, I finally found what I was looking for: professionalism, expertise, and courtesy. Ciro and his team are passionate about their work, advising you on what's best for you and your dog. My OttO, a tricolor roan cocker spaniel, needed a thorough grooming, and no one is as expert at this as Ciro. Congratulations!
TOP competence and professionalism!

The "Ciro Cordiola Academy" is a real treat for my puppies, they are great! Ciro is a true professional, competent like few others, even as a teacher as the whole team is highly trained! I truly wouldn't trade for anyone else! A real guarantee!
A true professional! A guarantee for my puppies.

A Master with a capital M.
I had the pleasure of taking a grooming course with Ciro Caraggio, and I couldn't have made a better choice. Ciro is an exceptional instructor, highly qualified and incredibly experienced in the field. Besides being extremely competent, he's also an excellent teacher: he explains clearly, is patient, and always available. If there's something that needs correcting, he points it out calmly and authoritatively, repeating it a thousand times if necessary, without ever losing his composure. His ability to convey confidence and serenity makes learning a pleasant and effective experience. What makes his teaching truly special is his love for this profession: it's clear that he does it with passion and dedication, and he transmits this love to everyone who follows him. Thanks to him, learning isn't just a technical process, but an experience that makes you appreciate this profession even more. I recommend his course to anyone who is serious about learning this profession!

Ciro Coraggio, a friendly and, above all, very competent instructor, a true professional and a true lover of his work. Highly recommended, whether you're studying with him or taking your furry friends with you.
